desktop_pairingUnsupported.message: This desktop app version doesn't support pairing. Update the app and try again.

desktop_incompatible.message: The desktop app version or protocol is incompatible. Update the app and try again.

desktop_pairRequestInvalid.message: Invalid pairing request. Pair again in the extension settings.

desktop_pairResponseInvalid.message: Invalid pairing response. Update the desktop app and try again.

desktop_pairDenied.message: The desktop app denied pairing. Nothing was sent. Pair again in the extension settings.

desktop_pairTokenInvalid.message: Invalid pairing token. Update the desktop app and try again.

desktop_pairNotApproved.message: Pairing wasn't approved. Confirm it in the desktop app and try again.

desktop_batchSize.message: Each local send supports 1 to 100 items. Send in smaller batches.

desktop_fieldTooLong.description: {field} is a field name such as title/url/note/content; {limit} is a number

desktop_bodyTooLarge.message: The local send exceeds the 2 MiB limit. Reduce the content or send in batches.

desktop_localStateInvalid.message: Invalid local pairing state. Reopen the extension settings.

desktop_readPairingFailed.message: Couldn't read the local pairing. Check the extension settings.

desktop_clearPairingFailed.message: Couldn't clear the local pairing. Check the extension settings.

desktop_discoveryInvalid.message: Invalid discovery request or pairing identity. Pair again.

desktop_tooManyRequests.message: Too many local connection requests. Close other extension settings pages and try again.

desktop_identityMismatch.message: The desktop app's identity or protocol doesn't match. No token or content was sent. Open the extension settings and reconnect.

justdoit_pageChanged.message: The selected page's address has changed. Select it again before collecting.

justdoit_readContentFailed.message: Couldn't read the page content. Check site access for this website.

justdoit_receiptInvalid.message: The desktop app returned an invalid receipt. Update the app and try again from the extension settings.

justdoit_networkFailed.message: Network request failed. Make sure the desktop app is running; if its port changed, reconnect in the extension settings.

justdoit_pairingRevoked.message: Pairing was revoked. Open the extension settings and pair again.

justdoit_serverStatus.message: The connection service returned {status}. Open the extension settings to check the address or desktop app version.

justdoit_receiptMismatch.message: The desktop app's receipt doesn't match, so the write wasn't confirmed. Open the extension settings to check the app version.

justdoit_notConfirmed.message: The service didn't confirm the send.

justdoit_sendIncomplete.message: Sending didn't complete. Open the extension settings to check the connection.

justdoit_endpointInvalid.message: Invalid connection address. Only local HTTP, or HTTPS without a password or query string, is supported.

options_connDesc.message: Click Connect and approve in the app; the app's actual port is then used automatically. Identity and pairing data stay in this browser only, are never synced or backed up, and nothing is sent automatically.

options_connBrowserHint.message: The app opens a local handshake page in your system's default browser. Use the browser profile that has this extension; if it opens in another browser or profile, come back here and retry. No port needs to be entered.

options_stateChecking.message: Checking the connection to the desktop app on this computer…

options_stateNotRunning.message: The app isn't responding or its port changed. Open the app and reconnect.

options_stateUnpaired.message: Not paired yet. Click Connect and approve in the app.

options_stateConnected.message: Desktop app on this computer is connected

options_statePairing.message: Pairing. Check the pairing code in the app.

options_stateError.message: Connection not completed. Follow the hint below and retry.

options_pairingCodeHint.message: Valid for three minutes; declining or canceling sends nothing.

options_currentEndpoint.message: Current send address: {url}. Connecting the desktop app switches back to the local address; a custom HTTPS address can be kept or chosen again in advanced settings.

options_advancedDesc.message: The local address is discovered and verified automatically; guessing ports manually and the old unauthenticated sending are not supported. Leave the field below empty and save to restore local mode. A custom HTTPS address keeps the original API format; saving requests access to that site, and the remote service receives the titles, URLs and page text you choose to send.

options_privacyDesc.message: Online wallpapers and site icons connect to their websites. Page text is extracted only when you click Collect; batch collection uses only the site access for the selected pages. Your tabs, bookmarks and page text are never sent to the developer.

options_quotesDesc.message: Off by default; when on, the new tab page fetches a short quote from the Hitokoto service.

options_footer.message: Settings apply instantly; refresh the new tab page to see them

options_msgSettingsLoadFailed.message: Couldn't read settings. Reopen the extension settings.

options_msgDiscoveryFailed.message: Couldn't prepare local discovery. Please retry.

options_msgWaitingHandshake.message: Waiting up to 20 seconds for the app to report its current port. Complete the handshake in the default browser that has this extension.

options_msgHandshakeIncomplete.message: Handshake not completed. Make sure the latest app is installed and the local handshake page opened in the browser profile that has this extension, then retry.

options_msgPairingApprove.message: Check the pairing code in the desktop app and approve. No tabs or page text are sent automatically.

options_msgPairingDone.message: Paired. The send address is now this computer. Selected content is collected and sent only when you click Send.

options_msgDisconnected.message: Disconnected and cleared the local pairing.

options_msgInvalidUrl.message: Advanced addresses must be custom HTTPS; the app reports the local port automatically, so leave it empty for local mode. The address can't contain credentials, query parameters or fragments.

options_msgUrlSaved.message: Connection address saved. Titles, URLs and selected page text are sent to it only when you click Send.

options_msgLocalRestored.message: Automatic local connection restored; the port comes from the paired app, so no address is needed.

options_msgWakeOnly.message: This only wakes the app. Click Connect and approve pairing in the app.

options_msgRevokeDone.message: Optional site access revoked. You'll need to authorize again to collect or use a custom connection.

options_msgRevokeFailed.message: Revoking not completed. Check the browser's extension settings.
